note: Where each collection is pulled from. The importer and the sync plugin both read this rather than carrying node ids in prose or in someone's memory.

pull.note: The board the sync plugin writes and Mason edits. One component set per icon, variants named 'Style=<Style>, Size=<Size>', each stamped with expressiveassets:id, :style, :size and :hash in shared plugin data. This is the canonical pull target as of 1 September 2026.

origin.note: The hand-built page the first 90 icons were imported from, kept for provenance. Superseded by the sync board above; do not import from both.
